summary_en: SANKEI REAL ESTATE REIT disclosed receipt of a non-binding letter of intent from a private equity fund with substantial investment track record regarding de-privatization of its investment units on November 5, 2026, during an ongoing public tender offer by City Index Fifth. The REIT maintains its previous neutral stance on the tender offer as of the disclosure date.
title_en: Notice of partial amendment regarding "Statement of endorsement and neutral opinion regarding public tender offer for investment units of SANKEI REAL ESTATE Inc. (Code: 2972) by City Index Fifth Co., Ltd."
translation_en_brief:
On November 5, 2026, SANKEI REAL ESTATE REIT announced receipt of a non-binding letter of intent from a private equity fund regarding de-privatization of its investment units. The fund had engaged in meetings with the REIT on October 16 and October 29, 2026, and submitted a confidentiality agreement on October 30, 2026, to commence due diligence on the REIT's properties, finances, tax matters, and legal aspects. The fund provided initial information on proposed transaction terms and anticipated timeline.

This development occurred while a public tender offer by City Index Fifth (the offeror) was ongoing. The offeror and its special related parties had previously indicated willingness to seriously negotiate subscription agreements to apply competing tenders for all investment units they own if a rival tender offer were launched, conditional on failure of the present offer. The REIT's board of officers had resolved on September 25, 2026, to express endorsement of the City Index Fifth tender offer while leaving the decision to apply to the discretion of unit holders.

As of November 5, 2026, the REIT's position regarding the City Index Fifth tender offer remained unchanged from the September 25, 2026 statement. The REIT confirmed it would disclose any further developments requiring material disclosure.
